##### Project general facts

Aila Homes is a premium community of three- and four-bedroom townhouses designed for modern families. Minimalist Scandinavian-inspired architecture, clean lines, balanced proportions and lush landscaping create a contemporary residential enclave that blends exclusivity, sophistication and natural beauty. Each townhouse comes with a private garden and generous interiors, offering space for family life, outdoor relaxation and entertaining. The community is planned as a calm, family-friendly neighbourhood with open green areas and walking paths.

Amenities support an active, balanced lifestyle for every generation. Residents can enjoy a swimming pool, a fully equipped gym and a spa, alongside a basketball court, a padel court and a running and cycling track. Families benefit from a kids' playground, a nature park and a dedicated pets' park, while a barbecue terrace and a multipurpose room offer places to gather with friends and neighbours. Retail outlets within the community add everyday convenience for residents.

Interiors are designed for families to flourish, with thoughtful layouts, refined finishes and a seamless flow between spaces. Floor-to-ceiling windows fill the living areas with natural light, while minimalist white and green palettes create a sense of purity and calm. Generous living and dining areas open towards private gardens, and bedrooms offer quiet, comfortable retreats. Homes are delivered with fitted kitchens and high-quality finishes, leaving furniture to the owner's own taste.

##### Location description and benefits

Al Hamra Village is a fully integrated master community on the coast of Ras Al Khaimah, home to luxury residences, a championship golf course, the Royal Yacht Club of Ras Al Khaimah and Al Hamra Marina. Five-star hotels such as Waldorf Astoria and The Ritz-Carlton Al Hamra Beach, together with beaches, lagoons and leisure facilities, create a resort-style setting for everyday life.

RAK Central lies within walking distance, and the golf course is right next to the community. Al Marjan Island and the Wynn Al Marjan Island resort are a short drive away, as is Al Hamra Mall. Ras Al Khaimah International Airport is easily reached, while Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road connects residents with Dubai and Dubai International Airport, and schools, clinics and supermarkets are found across the surrounding district.

Al Hamra Village is a freehold destination open to international buyers and one of the most established communities in Ras Al Khaimah. Strong growth in tourism and hospitality around Al Marjan Island supports demand for family homes and rental properties. Spacious townhouses with private gardens, accessible entry points compared with Dubai and a mature lifestyle offer make the area appealing to both end users and investors.
